import re

lines = sales_csv.strip().replace('\r\n', '\n').split('\n')
header = lines[0].split(',')
james_won = []
total = 0
for line in lines[1:]:
    fields = line.split(',')
    if len(fields) >= 7 and fields[1] == 'James Okafor' and fields[6] == 'won':
        amount = int(fields[4])
        total += amount
        james_won.append({
            'deal_id': fields[0],
            'region': fields[2],
            'product': fields[3],
            'amount': amount,
            'close_date': fields[5]
        })

# Format output
output_lines = []
output_lines.append(f"James Okafor — Won Deals in Q3 2026 ({len(james_won)} deals, ${total:,} total)")
output_lines.append("")
output_lines.append(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Region':<8} {'Product':<25} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12}")
output_lines.append("-" * 70)
for d in james_won:
    output_lines.append(f"{d['deal_id']:<10} {d['region']:<8} {d['product']:<25} ${d['amount']:>9,} {d['close_date']:<12}")
output_lines.append("-" * 70)
output_lines.append(f"{'TOTAL':<45} ${total:>9,}")

# Also note pending deal
output_lines.append("")
output_lines.append("Note: D020 (West, Meridian Insights Pro, $115,000) is still PENDING.")

formatted_output = '\n'.join(output_lines)
print(formatted_output)
